title: [CRY-17] JWS verification does not say which DID-document state a key is checked against
description: Review finding CRY-17: JWS verification does not say which DID-document state a key is checked against (lens CRY). Location: spec/13-encoding.md:76. Fix: 13:76 resolves `kid` with no time reference. Only 02:163 ("the DID document in effect before the assertion") states one. Archived compliance records, agreements and Space state signed by a later-revoked device key either fail verification or keep verifying for new objects, depending on how an implementer reads it. Fix as proposed: check new objects against the current document, and stored objects against the version recorded at acceptance (`versionId` or PLC operation CID). Revocation is not retroactive. Full text: notes/review/CRY-verified.md and notes/review/CRY.md.
